name: Kinetic scenario
description: Named actors, formations, assets, operations, events, facilities and operational areas involved in the preparation, conduct or aftermath of physical force.

entity_types.label: Armed force
entity_types.description: A specifically named national or institutional armed force.

entity_types.label: Military command
entity_types.description: A specifically named military command, headquarters or operational command.

entity_types.label: Military unit
entity_types.description: A formally organized and specifically named military formation or unit.
exclude_when: Do not use for an unnamed force concentration or a generic category such as infantry, artillery or special forces.

entity_types.label: Armed group
entity_types.description: A specifically named non-state, irregular or informal armed collective.

entity_types.label: Private military company
entity_types.description: A specifically named private military or security organization participating in kinetic activities.

entity_types.label: Joint force
entity_types.description: A specifically named multinational, inter-service or combined operational force.
examples: Combined Joint Task Force – Operation Inherent Resolve

entity_types.label: Peacekeeping force
entity_types.description: A specifically named peacekeeping, monitoring or stabilization force.

entity_types.label: Military base
entity_types.description: A specifically named military installation, garrison or operating base.

entity_types.label: Air base
entity_types.description: A specifically named military aviation base or airfield.

entity_types.label: Naval base
entity_types.description: A specifically named naval installation or military port.

entity_types.label: Forward operating base
entity_types.description: A specifically named forward operating base or advanced military position.

entity_types.label: Command post
entity_types.description: A specifically named or uniquely identified command-and-control facility.

entity_types.label: Military depot
entity_types.description: A specifically named ammunition, fuel, equipment or logistics depot.

entity_types.label: Defensive position
entity_types.description: A specifically named fortification, defensive complex or fixed military position.

entity_types.label: Checkpoint
entity_types.description: A specifically named or formally designated military, security or armed-group checkpoint.

entity_types.label: Military training area
entity_types.description: A specifically named military range, proving ground or training complex.

entity_types.label: Weapon system
entity_types.description: A specifically named weapon system, weapons family or integrated combat platform.

entity_types.label: Missile system
entity_types.description: A specifically named missile, missile family or missile-launch system.

entity_types.label: Artillery system
entity_types.description: A specifically named artillery, rocket-artillery or mortar system.

entity_types.label: Air-defense system
entity_types.description: A specifically named air- or missile-defense system.

entity_types.label: Combat vehicle model
entity_types.description: A specifically named tank, armored vehicle or military ground-platform model.

entity_types.label: Combat aircraft model
entity_types.description: A specifically named combat aircraft, helicopter or military unmanned-aircraft model.

entity_types.label: Naval platform class
entity_types.description: A specifically named class or design of military vessel or submarine.

entity_types.label: Military vehicle
entity_types.description: A specifically identified individual military land vehicle.

entity_types.label: Military aircraft
entity_types.description: A specifically identified individual military aircraft or unmanned aerial vehicle.

entity_types.label: Naval vessel
entity_types.description: A specifically identified individual naval or military-operated vessel.

entity_types.label: Military operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named coordinated military operation.

entity_types.label: Combat operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named operation involving direct combat activities.

entity_types.label: Air operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named coordinated air or air-defense operation.

entity_types.label: Naval operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named coordinated naval or maritime-security operation.

entity_types.label: Ground operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named coordinated land operation.

entity_types.label: Special operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named operation conducted by special-operations or similarly tasked forces.

entity_types.label: Counter-terrorism operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named counter-terrorism operation involving physical intervention.

entity_types.label: Evacuation operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named military or protected evacuation operation.

entity_types.label: Search-and-rescue operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named combat, maritime or military search-and-rescue operation.

entity_types.label: Battle
entity_types.description: A specifically named battle or sustained armed engagement.

entity_types.label: Siege
entity_types.description: A specifically named siege or encirclement event.

entity_types.label: Airstrike event
entity_types.description: A specifically named or uniquely identified airstrike event.
exclude_when: Do not annotate generic references to airstrikes without a distinct identity, target, date or conventional name.

entity_types.label: Missile-strike event
entity_types.description: A specifically named or uniquely identified missile-strike event.

entity_types.label: Naval engagement
entity_types.description: A specifically named naval battle or armed maritime encounter.

entity_types.label: Border clash
entity_types.description: A specifically named or conventionally identified armed border incident.

entity_types.label: Military exercise
entity_types.description: A specifically named military exercise or war game.

entity_types.label: Coup event
entity_types.description: A specifically named or conventionally identified coup or attempted coup.

entity_types.label: Infrastructure attack
entity_types.description: A specifically named or uniquely identified physical attack against critical infrastructure.

entity_types.label: Territorial occupation
entity_types.description: A specifically named or formally recognized occupation of a territory or settlement.

entity_types.label: Operational area
entity_types.description: A specifically named military theater, area of operations or operational zone.
examples: United States Central Command area of responsibility

entity_types.label: Front
entity_types.description: A specifically named military front or combat sector.

entity_types.label: Conflict zone
entity_types.description: A specifically named geographic area identified as an active or recent conflict zone.

entity_types.label: Demilitarized zone
entity_types.description: A specifically named demilitarized, buffer or disengagement zone.

entity_types.label: Humanitarian corridor
entity_types.description: A specifically named or formally designated humanitarian or evacuation corridor.

entity_types.label: Military supply route
entity_types.description: A specifically named military logistics, reinforcement or supply route.

entity_types.label: Ceasefire agreement
entity_types.description: A specifically named ceasefire, cessation-of-hostilities or armistice agreement.

entity_types.label: Disengagement agreement
entity_types.description: A specifically named agreement governing force separation, withdrawal or disengagement.

entity_types.label: Rules of engagement
entity_types.description: A specifically named or identified rules-of-engagement document.

entity_types.label: Battle-damage assessment
entity_types.description: A specifically named or identified assessment of physical damage resulting from military action.
